latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator Free Offline — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI-powered video generator tool for offline workflows.
- Supports creating videos from uploaded images, clips, and audio files (up to 500MB).
- Enables users to generate 30-second promo videos with text overlays, music, and simple instructions.
- No subscription or cloud upload required; session managed via local environment token or anonymous registration.
- Includes user-friendly workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and timeline previews.
- Built-in error handling for file formats, token expiry, credits, and export permissions.
